questions.question:
What will come in the place of ‘?’ in the following equation, if ‘÷’ and ‘–‘ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘+’ are interchanged?

7 + 4 ÷ 18 – 3 × 2 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

After decoding signs:

 
 

 Signs
 Decoded signs
 
 

 ÷
 -
 
 

 -
 ÷
 
 

 ×
 +
 
 

 +
 ×
 
 

 

Given equation: 7 + 4 ÷ 18 – 3 × 2 = ?

After interchanging the signs then:

⇒ 7 × 4 - __**18 ÷ 3**__ + 2 = ?

⇒ ? = __**7 ×**____** 4**__ - 6 + 2

⇒ ? = __**28**__ - 6 __**+ 2**__

⇒ ? = __**30 - 6 **__= 24

Hence, the correct answer is "24".

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

3 — 20 — 5

4 — 17 — 3

NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent

digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into

1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number × 3rd number) + 5 = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 3 — 20 — 5:

⇒ (3 × 5) + 5

⇒ 15 + 5 = 20.

For, 4 — 17 — 3:

⇒ (4 × 3) + 5

⇒ 12 + 5 = 17.

Similarly, for **9 — 77 — 8:**

**⇒ (9 × 8) + 5**

**⇒ 72 + 5 = 77.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to

be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given

statements.

Statements: All Grapes are Berries.

Some Berries are Juices.

All Juices are Sodas.

Conclusions: (I) Some Berries are Grapes.

(II) Some Sodas are Berries.

options.text: Both the conclusions (I) and (II) do not follow

questions.solution:
**Statements:**

All Grapes are Berries.

Some Berries are Juices.

All Juices are Sodas.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3d2c6e975d35c8f0f2a545aaf07ccf2539e5d714111f93c97a3c4aa7056bd67.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some Berries are Grapes. - **True **(because All Grapes are Berries given. So, Some Berries are Grapes too)

(II) Some Sodas are Berries. - **True **(because Some Berries are Juices and All Juices are Sodas. So, Some Sodas are Berries too)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both the conclusions (I) and (II) follow".**
